description: Get scan analytics for a specific QR code. Use this when the user wants to know how many times a QR code has been scanned, see daily scan trends, understand which devices are scanning, or see which countries scans come from. Returns total scans, scans by day, device breakdown (mobile/tablet/desktop), and top 5 countries.

days.description: Number of days of scan history to retrieve. Default: 30. Capped by plan: Free tier = 7 days max, Pro = 30 days, Business = 365 days.

id.description: The unique identifier of the QR code to get analytics for. Obtain this from quality_qr_list or quality_qr_create responses.

name: quality_qr_analytics
